Donald, your NerdQaxe++ was delivered back on August 9. What's still open is the one Hammer Miner BC04 that replaced the Gamma 602s, and it has not left the warehouse yet. Its date was September 25, so that's on us and I'm sorry.

I don't want to hand you another date I can't stand behind, so Abel and Georges have this in front of them now for the confirmed ship date. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in, and it comes to your email either way.

Handed to the team · Goodwill promised in chat for a 65-day wait on the BC04 line.

You've been more patient than we deserved, and I'm not going to pretend that wait was okay.

The B.04 is a real unit sitting in our US warehouse, not a pre-order, so it is going to you. What I don't have yet is the shipping date, and Abel and Georges are on that now.

For the wait I've put a $50 credit on this order, back to your card within 3 to 5 business days. Nothing you need to do.

Stay in the chat and one of them will come in with the date.
I'm tired of dealing with you and chasing you down just refund my money

I hear you, and I won't fight you on it.

One thing before I pass it over, Donald. The B.04 is in stock now. If you'd rather not wait on it, I can swap that line to another unit that's on the shelf and ships this week, at no cost to you. Say the word and I'll do it here.

If you'd still rather have the money back, say so and I'll put it through to Abel and Georges right now. It's an in-stock item that ran late, so it refunds in full, no restocking fee.

Abel told me last week that my order will be shipped out right away and it has not been shipped out all the items were supposed to arrive August 9th I was more than patient with you guys to deliver my product gave you every opportunity to make it right and you still have it
Handed to the team · Customer refused the swap and wants his money back on the unshipped line.

You're right, and I'm not going to argue any of it.

The refund is with Abel and Georges now, full amount on that line, no restocking fee, plus the $50. Money lands 3 to 5 business days after they issue it.

Stay in this chat if you can, one of them will come in and confirm it here. If you step away it comes to (email hidden), and you'll get a copy of this whole conversation there too.

I honestly don't believe anything you all say anymore but what can I do? I have been a customer for a long time but this has left me looking for other suppliers now and I really wanted to purchase the 40THs but I'm not risking anymore money.

That's fair, and I'm not going to talk you out of it. Trust gets earned back by a refund landing when we said it would, not by anything I type here.

So that's the one thing we owe you now. Abel and Georges have it, and you'll see it confirmed here or in your inbox.

The 40T will still be here if you ever feel like giving us another shot. No pressure from me either way, Donald.
